name: Min
description: This keyword returns the minimum value of the two inputs.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the minimum value of the two inputs.

![Example](./images/img-1632310972.png)

The above condition will return the minimum value, in this case 50

You can also input different series like close, EMA and find the minimum of the two. Make sure to use position keyword while selecting series as input

parameters.name: Value 2
parameters.description: Second value to compare. Returns the smaller of the two.
